bibliographic-data.invention-title: ASSISTANT AUTOMATISÉ INTELLIGENT POUR EXPLORATION DE CONTENUS MULTIMÉDIA
INTELLIGENT AUTOMATED ASSISTANT FOR MEDIA EXPLORATION

abstract.p: Systems and processes for operating an intelligent automated assistant are provided. In accordance with one example, a method includes, at an electronic device with one or more processors and memory, receiving a natural-language speech input; identifying, by the digital assistant, a task based on the natural-language speech input; providing, by the digital assistant, a speech output indicative of a verbal response associated with the identified task; while providing the speech output indicative of a verbal response: providing, by the digital assistant, playback of a media item corresponding to the verbal response.
